rules: Keep the mark simple enough to read at 16px.
Avoid decorative gradients, mascots and detailed illustrations.
Stay in the same visual family as the app mark.
Do not create a separate Bridge brand language.
Regenerate packaged icons from the active mark when the mark changes.

moduleIcons.style: stroke icon or minimal module mark using currentColor and design-system tokens
rules: Use the shared Icon component for product UI controls and module navigation.
Module icons must not introduce a separate palette.
Third-party provider logos are not module icons unless license and trademark usage are explicitly audited.

thirdPartyMarks.policy: reference by name or neutral module icon by default
rules: Do not copy upstream product logos into yaka-bridge before license and trademark review.
Use provider logos only as linked external attribution or after written distribution approval.
